covers: requests.post to api.openai.com endpoints: the URL from a module constant or a literal, the model read from a json= dict bound to a local and from data=json.dumps(...)
a model passed as a parameter inside the JSON body is a parameter gap on the raw HTTP request
httpx.post and a bare post imported from httpx to api.anthropic.com/v1/messages; a body with no model is a missing_model gap
requests.get, another host (a gateway) and the provider's /v1/models endpoint are not recorded; the HTTP libraries get no import records
notes: Synthetic. Truth is what each line does at run time, except where a policy turns it into a gap. A requests.post or httpx.post is recorded only when its URL resolves with no gap to a listed api.openai.com or api.anthropic.com endpoint; it routes direct and its model is read from the JSON body the way a dict expanded with ** is read. openai_rest.py:14 posts a local dict as json=, which requests.post only serializes, so the dict stays readable; :20 sends json.dumps(body) as data=; :24 puts a parameter in the body (a parameter gap); :28 is requests.get to /v1/models, not recorded. anthropic_rest.py:11 uses httpx.post with a module-constant URL; :15 is post imported from httpx and its body names no model (missing_model); :19 posts to a gateway host, which records nothing, so its model is never output. No header, key or API version is ever output.
